      Backroom Deal

      How to Play

      01 · Getting In

      Quick Start

      1. Create or join a room

        The host taps Create Room and shares the 5-letter room code. Everyone else taps Join Room and enters it.

      2. Customize your stickman

        Pick a hair and face, or hit Random. Purely cosmetic.

      3. Get to 2–6 players, all Ready

        Not enough humans? The host can hit Add Bot to fill empty seats with AI players.

      4. Host hits Start Match

        Turns rotate seat by seat. On your turn, pick exactly one move.

      02 · The Goal

      The Political Ladder

      Four ranks, climbing bottom to top. Seat counts scale with table size — President is always exactly one seat.

      Ahli BiasaOrdinary MemberEveryone starts here.
      ↑ promote or seize the seat above ↑
      Ketua ADUNDistrict ChiefFirst rung up.
      ↑
      Timbalan PresidenDeputy PresidentFewer seats, higher stakes.
      ↑
      PresidenPresidentThe top. Always exactly one seat.
      03 · Your Numbers

      Reading Your Stats

      💰Money (Duit)

      Spent on Kempen Imej and (Advanced Mode) Black Market. Earned mainly from Projek. Lose 50% instantly if Scandal maxes out.

      ⭐Influence

      Spent on Politik, Sabotaj, and Political Raid. Also earned from Projek.

      👍Approval Rating

      Public standing, starts at 50%. Decides who Parliament can target with a Vote of No Confidence.

      ⚠️Scandal
      Bersih 0%Diperhati 30%Disiasat 60%Ditahan 100%
      At 100%: lose 50% of your Money, drop one rank, and Scandal resets to 30%.
      04 · On Your Turn

      Your Six Moves

      Pick exactly one per turn. Colors match the buttons you'll see in-game.

      Projek

      Dapatkan duit dan influence, tapi risiko skandal naik. Always succeeds.

      no cost+💰 +⭐+⚠️ scandal
      Politik

      Tekan butang POLITIK di bawah kerusi kosong satu pangkat di atas anda — terus cuba naik pangkat. Promotes into an EMPTY seat one rank up.

      costs ⭐needs open seat% chance
      Sabotaj

      Tekan butang SABOTAJ di bawah penghuni kerusi penuh satu pangkat di atas — terus serang. Steals an OCCUPIED seat one rank up.

      costs ⭐needs full seat% chance
      Kempen Imej

      Bayar media untuk kurangkan skandal anda. Or gain Influence / Public Support.

      costs 💰−⚠️ scandal
      Political Raid

      Cuba rampas Aset Politik pemain lain. Risky bid to steal a rival's asset — you can't steal a type you already own (no duplicates).

      costs ⭐% chancesteals asset
      Black Market

      Advanced Mode sahaja. Beli Aset Politik terus: RM60,000 and +50% Scandal. Limited shared stock (2 items per player).

      costs 💰+50% scandallimited stock
      05 · Anytime, Not Just Your Turn

      🤝 Backroom Deal

      Either player can offer or answer a Backroom Deal at any time — Money and/or Influence, only the two of you ever see it. A deal never leaks by itself: it stays a secret between you two, with no public trace, until someone chooses to Dedahkan a broken contract.

      Syarat. A deal can come with a condition: vote YA/TIDAK in the next Parliament vote, don't Sabotaj/Raid/smear you for two rounds, Sabotaj a named rival, or stay out of the seat above you. Half the payment is paid up front; the other half is held and goes to them if they keep their word, or straight back to you if they don't. If they break it, tap Dedahkan (free) in your Kontrak list: they must hand back what they were paid up front plus pay a RM5,000 fine and 100 Influence, take +30% Scandal, drop one seat and carry a public Pecah Amanah mark (shown as KHIANAT). You take +10% Scandal and a RM5,000 fine for being in on it, but keep your seat.

      Dedahkan dijamin 🛡️. Exposing a broken contract can't be dodged by spending the money: they must hand back everything they were paid up front. Whatever they can no longer cover is taken as debt — their Money (or Influence) goes negative and their next income pays it off first. The fine, Scandal hit, lost seat and Pecah Amanah mark always apply in full. Dedahkan counts on its own: the Scandal it adds stops at 99%, so it can't also set off the 100% Scandal penalty in the same go.

      Sembang rahsia 💬. While a deal is waiting for an answer, and for as long as a contract exists, the two of you can chat privately (200 characters a message, no spamming). Only you two ever receive it, and the host keeps the record — you can't edit or deny what you said. A bot answers with a stock line.

      06 · Public & Stealable

      Political Assets

      Permanent passive bonuses, visible to the whole table on purpose. Normal match: everyone starts with 1 random asset. Advanced Mode: nobody does — buy from the Black Market (limited stock). Political Raid can steal a type you don't already own. Nobody holds two of the same asset.

      📺Media EmpirePassive Influence every round.
      🏦Corporate SponsorExtra Money from every Projek.
      ⚙️Party MachineryHigher Politik success chance.
      👑Royal ConnectionLower chance of being Sabotaj'd or Kabel'd.
      07 · Symbols You'll See

      Badges & Special Icons

      HOST
      Host tag

      Controls settings and Start Match / can skip a stalled turn.

      BOT
      Bot tag

      AI-controlled seat. Plays automatically on a short delay.

      🛡️2
      Public Support

      Temporary shield from Kempen Imej. Number = turns left.

      🕴️
      KABEL

      Secret legendary card. One-time use: challenge any occupied seat above you.

      🎯
      Secret Objective

      Private goal with its own payout. Hidden from everyone else, even at match end.

      🏛️
      Parliament Voting

      Full-table vote fires periodically (90s timer). Vote Yes or No. Anyone who doesn't vote in time is counted as an abstention (shown in the result, but not counted). Motion passes only if Yes beats No.

      08 · Out of Anyone's Control

      National Events

      Random world events fire on a timer if the host leaves them on. They hit every player equally.

      📈Economic Boom
      📉Recession
      ❤️Public Holiday
      🚨Anti-Corruption
      🗳️Election Season
      📺Media Frenzy
      💸Gov. Budget
      ⚡Parliament Crisis
      09 · Playing Solo

      Playing with Bots

      • In the lobby, the host taps Add Bot once per open seat — each click adds one, tagged BOT. A ✕ next to a bot removes it before the match starts.
      • Bots take real turns — Projek, Politik, Sabotaj, Kempen Imej, Political Raid, Black Market — on a short visible delay.
      • They'll send you Backroom Deal offers unprompted, and accept or reject offers you send them based on how good the offer is.
      • Bots never cast a Parliament vote — they abstain, so the vote doesn't wait for them.
      10 · Mode Watak

      The 12 Characters

      With Mode Watak on, everyone is secretly dealt one different character. Your own character is shown only to you until the match ends.

      How Mode Watak works

      • Powers are free. Use one special per turn, on your own turn, alongside your normal action. Each has its own cooldown (in rounds) or limit per game.
      • Public Trust is your approval (starts at 50%). It breaks ties at the end, nudges your Politik chance, and is what exposure, campaigns and endorsements move.
      • Every accepted Backroom Deal adds +20% Scandal to both sides (the Fixer pays +5% when starting one) and leaves a hidden Evidence Token. The accepter loses 1% Public Trust.
      • Exposure. A deal exposed after acceptance costs the starter RM20,000, 200 Influence and a turn; the accepter RM2,000 and 200 Influence; both +20% Scandal. Each token can be exposed only once.
      • Investigations always succeed with 50% plus 0.3 x the target's Scandal (at most 90%). A failed search and an empty one look the same. The Bureaucrat can make a Spy or Journalist see forged evidence, so not everything you read is true.
      • Shields. The Lawyer and Ally cut the next eligible money penalty from an exposed deal (never more than 50% in total, never Dedahkan).
      • National Events in Mode Watak: Leaked Audio, Anti-Corruption Commission, Public Trust Collapse and Parliamentary Inquiry, each lasting a round.
      • Copycat. The Opportunist becomes a full copy of one character in the match for good, without knowing who holds it.
      Match End

      Whoever holds the highest rank when the final round ends, wins. Ties break by lowest Scandal, then by seat order.
